'''Rob Ronnlund Bothawui Speeder Blitz''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rob Ronnlund]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls113.htm Bothawui Speeder Blitz], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010227192614/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls113.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
